Pass one via reporter argument cucumber::test() cucumber::run(). ✨ Missing step definitions now report ready--paste snippet ({int}/{string} placeholders inferred step text) instead just error. 🐛 Feature file normalisation now preserves original Given//keyword (resolving //* preceding one) instead collapsing every step generic keyword. 🐛 Doc String content now dedented relative opening delimiter, Gherkin specification requires.
